actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, multiplicity-adjusted transcriptional identity evidence (18/50 HALLMARK pathways, large consistent down-regulation), no technical confounder association, and stable internal structure with moderate multi-modal membership support. No material unresolved question remains and no structural revision is indicated.

C0002 shows convergent BAP1-enriched mutational and transcriptional identity evidence with stable internal structure. A tissue-source-site association is a plausible partial competing explanation, but it is moderate and does not negate the convergent molecular signal; retained for downstream validation with this caveat.

C0003 is defined by a strong, adjusted near-universal VHL-mutant/PBRM1-sparse mutational profile with no technical confounder association. Structure is essentially single-modality (WXS) with weak cross-modal agreement, but this is consistent with a mutation-defined group and no structural revision is supported; retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has strong PBRM1-dominant mutational evidence plus a coherent up-regulated transcriptional program, with no adjusted technical confounder. Internal structure is the least stable among sets but remains estimable and defensible; no split or merge is supported, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 is defined by adjusted VHL/PBRM1-sparse and MUC16-enriched mutational signals with no technical confounder association. Structure is highly resample-stable though WXS-driven, consistent with a mutation-defined group; no structural revision is supported, so it is retained for downstream validation.
